children: StimCell Energetics entered into an Advisory Services Agreement with Stonegate Capital Markets to support investor outreach and strategic introductions. Stonegate will provide quarterly research, ongoing investor relations consultation, and coordinate targeted institutional investor meetings on a non-exclusive, best-efforts basis. Fees are tied to gross proceeds from qualifying transactions approved by the company. The agreement starts with a three-month term and can be terminated thereafter on 30 days' notice.
